Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:11:1.hebrew: סתם מאן דזבין ארעא (לחבריה) באלפא זוזי אוזיל ומזבין - סתם איש הקונה קרקע גדולה ויקרה כזו, אין כל כך מעות מצויות לו אלא אם כן מכר מטלטלין ושדות קטנות, וצריך למכור בזול. וכי חוזר בו מוכר, נמצא זה ניזק על ידו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:11:1.english: Ordinarily, one who buys land (to his fellow) for a thousand zuz lowers [the price] and sells - Ordinarily, a person who buys such a large and expensive [plot of] land does not have so much money readily available unless he sells movable property and small fields, and he must sell [them] cheaply. And when the seller retracts, this [buyer] is found to be harmed on his account.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:11:2.hebrew: ותנן הניזקין שמין להן בעידית - לגבות מעידית נכסיו של מזיק, כדכתיב (שמות כ״ב:ד׳) מיטב שדהו ישלם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:11:2.english: And we learned: For injured [parties], they appraise [payment] in superior-quality [land] - To collect from the superior-quality [land] of the damager’s property, as it is written (Exodus 22:4), “the best of his field he shall pay.”

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:12:1.english: That he wrote this - That he established [the balance] against him as a loan.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:15:1.hebrew: בד"א - שיכול לחזור בו, ולא יטול זה אלא כנגד מעותיו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:15:1.english: In what [case] are these words stated - That he can retract, and this one will take only commensurate with his money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:15:2.english: When - [Meaning] that he gave it to him as a security deposit, and not as the beginning of payment.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:15:3.hebrew: דאמר ליה ערבוני יקון - יקנה הכל, והאי לא אוזיל גביה למכור לו כל הקרקע בכך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:15:3.english: That he said to him, "My down payment will acquire" - [i.e.,] it shall acquire everything, and this [seller] did not lower the price for him to sell him the entire land for that [amount].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:15:4.hebrew: אבל - נתנו לו בתורת תחלת פרעון, הוו להו השאר מלוה עליו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:15:4.english: But - [where] he gave it to him as an initial payment, the rest becomes a loan upon him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:15:5.english: He has acquired - The entire land.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:15:6.english: And he returns the rest to him - Even after several years.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:16:1.hebrew: הא דעייל ונפיק אזוזי - האי דקתני דאי לא זקפו עליו במלוה חוזר, בדעייל מוכר ונפיק ומחזר אחר הלוקח ליתן לו מעותיו. גלי דעתיה דזוזי אנסוהו למכור, וכיון דלא יהיב ליה זוזי בשעת דחקו, אדעתא דהכי לא זבין ליה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:16:1.english: This [is] where he goes in and goes out for money - That [baraita] which teaches that if he did not establish [the balance] against him as a loan he may retract [refers to a case] where the seller goes in and goes out and searches after the buyer to give him his money. He [thereby] revealed his intent that [need for] money forced him to sell, and since [the buyer] does not give him the money at the time of his pressing need, he did not sell [it] to him with that understanding.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:19:1.english: Who sold him a chamara - A donkey.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:19:2.english: And there remained - with the buyer, one zuz.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:19:3.english: And he was going in and going out - The seller [was going in and going out] for that zuz.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:19:4.english: In a case like this - On account of one zuz, do we say that he can retract?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:1:1.hebrew: נותן לו שכרו - הואיל ואנוס הוא, אין לקנסו ולעשות ידו על התחתונה, ונותן לו חצי דמי שכרו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:1:1.english: He gives him his wage - Since he is [prevented by] unavoidable circumstances, one should not penalize him and put him at a disadvantage, and [the employer] gives him half the value of his wage.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:2:1.hebrew: ש"מ - מדנקט אונס בתרוייהו, הא לא אניסי, לא, ואפילו שכירות נמי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:2:1.english: Learn from it - Since [the baraita] specifies unavoidable accident in both [cases], [this implies that if] they were not prevented by unavoidable accident, [they do] not [receive full payment], and even [in the case of] hired labor as well.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:3:1.hebrew: אמר ר"נ בר יצחק - לעולם שאני ליה, ומודה הוא בשכיר דידו על העליונה. והא דנקט אונס בשכיר, אפי' רבנן נמי אמרי ליה, דאי לא אניס לא הדר, כ"ש ר' דוסא. והא מתניתין בדבר האבוד עסקינן, ודברי הכל אין הפועל יכול לחזור בו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:3:1.english: Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said - In fact, he [Rabbi Dosa] does differentiate [between a hired laborer and a contractor], and he concedes regarding a hired laborer that he has the upper hand. And as for [the baraita] mentioning unavoidable circumstances regarding a hired laborer, even the Rabbis also state it — that if he was not prevented by unavoidable circumstances, he may not retract — and all the more so Rabbi Dosa! For [in] this teaching we are dealing with a matter involving financial loss, and [according to] everyone, the laborer cannot retract.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:4:1.hebrew: כר' יהודה - פלוגתייהו בפרק הגוזל עצים (ב"ק ק:): לצבוע לו אדום וצבעו שחור וכו', ולקמן בפירקין (בבא מציעא דף עח:) מייתי לה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:4:1.english: In accordance with Rabbi Yehuda - Their dispute [is] in the chapter [entitled] HaGozel Etzim (Bava Kamma 100b): "to dye it red for him, and he dyed it black," etc., and later in our chapter (Bava Metzia 78b) [the Gemara] cites it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:4:2.hebrew: לאו לאתויי שכיר יום - דרישא דמתני' תנא אומנין, דמשמע קבלנות, ותנא בהן "ידו על התחתונה". הדר תנא "כל החוזר", לאתויי פועל:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:4:2.english: Is it not to include a day laborer - For [in] the first clause of the Mishnah it taught [regarding] craftsmen, which implies contracting [work], and it taught regarding them [that] "he is at a disadvantage." Then it taught "whoever reneges," to include a laborer.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:6:1.hebrew: ואיבעית אימא כל החוזר בו - לאו לאתויי פועל, דרחמנא אקיל גביה, אלא לאתויי הך חזרה דתניא וכו':
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:6:1.english: And if you wish, say: Whoever reneges - [This is] not [coming] to include a worker, for the Merciful One was lenient with him; rather, [it is] to include this [case of] reneging that is taught [in the baraita], etc.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:7:1.english: From where does he let him collect - [Meaning,] he lets him collect his debt.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:7:2.english: From the superior-quality [land] - And later on, [the Gemara] explains the reason.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:8:1.hebrew: מלמדין אותן - לכל הלוקח ואין לו מעות כולן אלא מקצתן, לעשות ביניהם תחלה דבר קיום שלא יוכלו לחזור:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:8:1.english: We teach them - [We teach] anyone who buys and does not have all the money, but [only] part of it, to establish between them at the outset something binding so that they cannot renege.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:8:2.hebrew: והרי אני נושה בו - דכיון שעשאם עליו מלוה, הוה כאילו נטלם והלוום, וקרקע נקנית בכסף:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:8:2.english: And behold, he owes me - For once he made them a loan upon him, it is as if he took them and lent them [back] to him, and land is acquired with money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:9:1.hebrew: מעידית דנכסים - דשאר נכסיו, שאם יש לו קרקע יפה מזו, יטול בה בשוה מאתים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:9:1.english: From the superior-quality [land] of the property - [That is,] of the rest of his property, so that if [the seller] has land better than this [plot], [the buyer] takes from it to the value of two hundred [zuz].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:9:2.hebrew: לא יהא אלא בעל חוב - לא יהא לוקח זה דינו קל, אלא אפי' הוא חמור כבעל חוב, שיש לחוש בו לנעילת דלת, אף הוא לא יפה כחו ליטול עידית אלא בינונית:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 77b:9:2.english: Should he be nothing more than a creditor - This buyer's law should not be [treated as] lenient; rather, even if he is [considered as] stringent as a creditor, regarding whom one must be concerned about closing the door [to borrowers], even he does not have the power to take superior-quality [land], only intermediate-quality [land].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 77b:10:1.hebrew: מעידית שבה ומזיבורית שבה - והא דלא שקיל מבינונית שבה, משום דקנסו את החוזר בו; אבל מעיקרא פריך שאין לקנסו כ"כ ולהגבותו עידית דעלמא:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 77b:10:1.english: From the superior-quality [land] that is in it, and from the inferior-quality [land] that is in it - And [the reason] that he does not take from the intermediate-quality [land] that is in it is because they penalized the one who reneges; however, initially [the Gemara] objected that one should not penalize him so much [as] to have him collect superior-quality [land] in general.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 77b:11:1.hebrew: והוה ליה מזיק - לאו דוקא מזיק, שהרי אין שמין כפי הנזק שהזיקו, שהרי אינו משלם אלא כפי המעות שקבל; אלא קצת דימוהו למזיק, ליטול חובו מן העידית:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 77b:11:1.english: And he is a damager - Not literally a damager, for they do not appraise [the liability] according to the damage he caused him, since he pays only according to the money he received; rather, they somewhat likened him to a damager, so that [the buyer] collects his debt from superior-quality [land].

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 77b:17:1.hebrew: עייל ונפיק אזוזי לא קני - נראה דאיירי אפי' משך המקח, אם לא פירש בשעת מכירה: "משיכה זו תהא קונה חפץ זה, וזוזי ליהוו הלואה גבאי", כמו בשטר דאמר לעיל: "אני פלוני מכרתי" כו'; דאין סברא לומר דלענין "מי שפרע" מיירי:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 77b:17:1.english: He goes in and goes out for money — he has not acquired [it] - It appears that [this] refers even [to a case where the buyer] performed meshikhah on the purchased item, if he did not explicitly state at the time of the sale: "Let this meshikhah acquire this object, and let the money be a loan with me," as in [the case of] a deed that [the Gemara] mentioned above: "I, so-and-so, sold..." etc.; for it is not logical to say that [Rava] is speaking with regard to [the curse of] "He who exacted punishment" (mi shepara).

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 77b:20:1.hebrew: תתרגם שמעתיך במוכר שדהו מפני רעתה - ונראה דהשתא אפילו נפיק ועייל בכולהו זוזי קני, ולאו דוקא חד זוזא, כדאמרי' בסמוך: "ולא טרח וזבין במאתים וקא עייל ונפיק אזוזי, כמוכר שדהו מפני רעתה דמי או לא":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 77b:20:1.english: Interpret your halakha with regard to one who sells his field due to its poor [quality] - And it appears that now, even if [the seller] goes in and goes out for all the money, [the buyer] acquires [it], and not specifically [only when] one dinar [is owed], as [the Gemara] says shortly thereafter: "and he did not trouble himself and sold [property] for two hundred, and goes in and goes out for the money — is he considered like one who sells his field due to its poor [quality], or not?"

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 77b:5:1.hebrew: רב פליג עליה בחדא - וא"ת: בפ' הגוזל קמא (ב"ק קב. ושם), דאמר דהלכה כמתני' דכל המשנה ידו על התחתונה, משום דתני לה בהדי הלכתא פסיקתא דכל החוזר בו — והלא אין הלכה כהך דכל החוזר בו, וסתמא הלכה כרב דפליג עליה? וי"ל: דהתם סבר כאיבעית אימא דהכא, דשפיר סבר רב כמתני' דכל החוזר. א"נ: כיון דתנא לה תנא גבי הלכתא פסיקתא, אם כן סבר התנא דהכי הלכתא דכל המשנה ידו על התחתונה; ונהי דבההיא דכל החוזר אין הלכה, מ"מ ההיא דכל המשנה הויא הלכה, דלא אשכחן אמורא דפליג עליה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 77b:5:1.english: Rav disagrees with him in one [matter] - And if you ask: In the chapter [entitled] HaGozel Kamma (Bava Kamma 102a, and there [in Tosafot]), where [the Gemara] says that the halakhah is like the Mishnah of "anyone who deviates has the lower hand" because [the Tanna] taught it alongside the decided halakhah (hilkheta pesikta) of "anyone who retracts" — is not the halakhah not like that [ruling] of "anyone who retracts," and presumably the halakhah follows Rav who disagrees with him? One can answer: There, [the Gemara] holds like the "if you wish, say" (ibbayit eima) [answer] here, that Rav indeed holds like the Mishnah of "anyone who retracts." Alternatively: Since the Tanna taught it alongside a decided halakhah, if so, the Tanna held that such is the halakhah regarding "anyone who deviates has the lower hand"; and although regarding that [ruling] of "anyone who retracts" the halakhah does not [follow it], nevertheless that [ruling] of "anyone who deviates" is the halakhah, since we do not find an Amora who disagrees with it.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 77b:9:1.hebrew: לא יהא אלא בע"ח - אבל מזיבורית לא קשה ליה, דכי נמי הוי כבע"ח, אוקמוה אדאורייתא דהוי בזיבורית, דהכא לא שייך נעילת דלת. וכי משני "מזיבורית שבה", לא היה צריך, דמזיבורית לא הוה קשה ליה מידי כדפרישית, אלא מוקי לה הכי דליהוי זיבורית שבה כמו עידית שבה. אי נמי: כי היכי דלא תקשי הלא לב"ח לא מסלקי' בארעא כי אית ליה זוזי ללוה, וכי משני "מזיבורית שבה" א"ש, הכא דלא משלם זוזי לפי שנתקיים המקח כנגד המעות שנתן:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 77b:9:1.english: Even if he is only a creditor - However, regarding inferior-quality land, [the Gemara] has no difficulty, for even if he is like a creditor, they established [his law] according to biblical law, where it is from inferior-quality land, since [the concern of] "closing the door [before borrowers]" does not apply here. And when [the Gemara later] answers "from the inferior-quality land in it," it was not necessary [to answer this for the sake of inferior-quality land], since regarding inferior-quality land there was no difficulty at all, as I have explained; rather, it interprets it thus so that "inferior-quality land in it" corresponds to "superior-quality land in it." Alternatively: so that one should not ask, "Surely we do not pay off a creditor with land when the borrower has money!" And when [the Gemara] answers "from the inferior-quality land in it," it works out well [as to why] here he does not pay money, because the sale is fulfilled corresponding to the money he gave.
